_about: Public-domain B. H. Carroll (Benajah Harvey Carroll, 1843-1914, Baptist, founder of Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary) for the Word Hoard: his Sermons with a life sketch (1893) and nine volumes of An Interpretation of the English Bible in the Revell printings of 1913-1917, edited by J. B. Cranfill, raw Internet Archive OCR. The other volumes exist only in post-1942 Broadman reprints and are left out. Not his son B. H. Carroll Jr. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

carroll-sermons-1893: Sermons and Life Sketch of B. H. Carroll, compiled by J. B. Cranfill (Philadelphia: American Baptist Publication Society; copyright 1893)
carroll-exodus-leviticus: An Interpretation of the English Bible: Exodus and Leviticus (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1913)
carroll-revelation: An Interpretation of the English Bible: The Book of Revelation (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1913)
carroll-daniel: An Interpretation of the English Bible: Daniel and the Inter-Biblical Period (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1915)
carroll-pastoral-epistles: An Interpretation of the English Bible: The Pastoral Epistles of Paul, I and II Peter, Jude, and I, II and III John (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1915)
carroll-four-gospels-2: An Interpretation of the English Bible: The Four Gospels, vol. 2 (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1916)
carroll-james-thess-cor: An Interpretation of the English Bible: James, I and II Thessalonians, I and II Corinthians (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1916)
carroll-galatians-romans: An Interpretation of the English Bible: Galatians, Romans, Philippians, Philemon (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1916)
carroll-hebrew-monarchy: An Interpretation of the English Bible: The Hebrew Monarchy (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1916)
carroll-colossians-ephesians-hebrews: An Interpretation of the English Bible: Colossians, Ephesians and Hebrews (New York: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1917)
